0.content: Anya "Marie" Andersdotter, the Hexenzirkel's writer, signed her works "M". Touched by an old poem written from the evil dragon Durin's point of view, she wrote a new story whose hero bore the name Durin, hoping to give that tragedy a kinder ending. She cherished Simulanka's people as her own children. She also refused to confine Durin there, despite Barbeloth's warning that her dragon could not escape the fate of the original. Before she died she asked him to leave Simulanka and see the world, and gave Alice her pen so he could one day write in her place. Durin never felt her embrace, but her voice guided him through his stories; he believes she is a star watching over him.

1.content: Albedo called Mini Durin to Mondstadt to deal with the old dragon's reviving heart and offered the fusion that made him human. As alchemical beings living in human form, they consider themselves family, and Durin finds peace in calling Albedo his brother. Albedo teaches him about work, ideals and life, encourages him to accept compliments, and now teaches him alchemy ("common sense in this world"). Durin calls him the perfect human, yet senses a side no one would expect: decisive measures to reach his aims. He wonders if that intuition is a resonance between beings of the same "species".

2.content: In Simulanka the Wanderer, cast as the story's "hero", was the one who understood the cursed dragon. He became the first friend to call Durin by name, and Durin left the story to follow him. In Sumeru the Wanderer guarded him with a gloomy glare that scared off the curious and the traffickers of exotic beasts. Durin could see a story in everyone except him. When the Wanderer tried to end their journey, Durin refused to go until he knew his story. The Wanderer told him to see the world's beauty and ugliness before choosing whether to plant his story there, and to remember the small part he had played. Durin saw him as a stray cat.

3.comment: Durin: The original Durin (the evil dragon)
3.content: The first Durin was an Abyssal dragon made by the alchemist Rhinedottir in Khaenri'ah, classified as "Humus". His consciousness came from beyond the heavens and was fused with a dragon body. In the cataclysm five hundred years ago he invaded Mondstadt, poisoning the land, while the Knights were away on a campaign. Barbatos summoned Dvalin, who tore open Durin's throat over the mountain Vindagnyr. The corpse fell there, and the mountain became Dragonspine. Dvalin swallowed the poisoned blood, which later helped turn him into "Stormterror".

4.content: During a limited-time 4.8 event, the Traveler, Paimon, Kirara, Navia, Nilou and the Wanderer entered Simulanka, Andersdotter's storybook world. Its people called the giant toy-block dragon the "Evil Dragon" who would "steal the stars". In truth he only wanted friends and to see his mother, whom he believed had become a star. Each visitor gave him a blessing. The Traveler's was: "May you find friendship and goodwill, no matter where you go." The curse lifted and he shrank into a small dragon who could touch things without turning them into blocks. Alice named him Mini Durin and said the Traveler's blessing from beyond the story might let him explore other worlds.

5.content: Mini Durin came to Mondstadt during the Windblume Festival and stayed hidden, fearing people would be scared, though he secretly helped the Traveler in battle and slipped off to enjoy the festival. He told them he would replace the Durin of Dragonspine. He was not sure "want" was the right word, but he wanted his life to mean something and was not afraid of change; no one was forcing him. Albedo performed the Art of Khemia with Hexenzirkel reagents. When the light faded, Durin stood in a human body with a Pyro Vision at his side of the array.
